text:
Leah Kim: Kickoff: CloudMarket wants us to ingest their hourly usage blobs and provide a daily invoice-preview + weekly reconciliation. They require SLA for preview delivery and an ops playbook if deltas exceed threshold. Who volunteers?

Omar Raza: I'll own ingestion + SKU mapping. Need to confirm their blob schema: per-account hourly rows or per-device?

Mark (CloudMarket): We send per-account hourly rows: account_id, hour_ts, bytes_used, signed_manifest. We can include account_tier tag. Daily preview requested at 03:00 UTC for previous UTC day.

Priya Shah: Marketing: need marketplace copy and friendly tier names. Avoid raw metric names in public messaging.

Leah Kim: Reconciliation expectations? Should we run a 5-day shadow and require deltas <0.7% to approve GA?

Omar Raza: Proposed runbook: 1) 7-day shadow run on staging 2) daily preview CSV with columns: account_id, sku, period_start, period_end, our_units_bytes, partner_units_bytes, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents, delta_pct, notes 3) alert if delta_pct >0.7% or absolute >500 GB --> open MP ticket.

Mark (CloudMarket): We can accept 48h late-arrivals. We'll provide replay tooling and signed manifests.

Priya Shah: Marketing wants two sample previews (low/high) and mapping table by day 3. Also require final numbers 8 business days before announcement.

Leah Kim: Security/legal: Cara, any compliance concerns about signed manifests and replay?

Cara (Legal): Ensure contract includes agreed tolerance and a clause for provisional invoices if reconciliation fails. Also request retention and audit log access for at least 12 months.

Omar Raza: I'll implement validator: check manifest checksum, HMAC signature, dedupe by event_id, aggregate per-account-hour to bytes-day. Will post sample CSV.

ops-bot: Created ticket MP-901: "CloudMarket hourly blobs onboarding + preview SLA" assigned to Omar Raza.

Leah Kim: Action items: Omar -> mapping + sample CSV by Tue EOD; Priya -> marketplace labels + sample copy; Mark -> provide sample blobs & replay instructions; Cara -> sample contract clause. Reconvene after day 3 of shadow run. :thumbsup:
